sources.title: Socratic AI: The Socratic Approach to AI for Human Creativity
sources.snippet: Socratic AI, n. Coined by Jay Dixit · socraticai.co · 2025 using AI to support, inspire, and elicit human creativity — without ever outsourcing the writing, the ideas, or the thinking to the machine. "I use AI in my writing process, but always Socratically, never to generate prose or ideas." using AI as a sounding board to talk out your ideas when you're stuck, so you spend more time ...

sources.title: GitHub - SuccessMoses/SocraticAI
sources.snippet: Rather than providing direct answers, SocraticAI guides students to discover solutions themselves—truly "teaching them to fish." Leveraging the native multimodality of Gemma 4 and high-performance on-device inference via Google AI Edge's LiteRT, SocraticAI provides a private, intelligent, and responsive learning environment.
